messages:
Rae (Product): Heads-up: large EU prospect asked for roadmap + launch criteria for multi-tenant isolation and regional routing. They want options and ETA.

Nina (Infra): Short take: three paths - Shielded (dedicated pools), Affinity (region-aware steering), and Hybrid (shielded pilot + affinity for rest).

Eli (Architecture): Agree. We should attach concrete gates: provisioning SLA, p50/p99 targets, model-fallback parity, and telemetry coverage.

Priya (SRE): Ops needs: automated canary rollback, noisy-tenant eviction plan, per-tenant traces, and runbook IDs. Canary gate: 48h no customer-facing errors.

Maya (Security): Customer requires KMS BYOK, audit log export, and data residency attestation. Legal needs exact wording.

Jules (Sales): They'll pay for Shielded pilot. Need a 6-8 week pilot timeline and one-pager for InfoSec.

Rae (Product): Quick tradeoff notes I put here: Shielded = latency + compliance, slower + cost. Affinity = fast + cheaper, weaker isolation. Hybrid = pragmatic but more ops.

Eli (Architecture): Sample routing pseudo: if region=="eu" && label=="shielded" -> pool("eu-shielded") else prefer(pool("eu-affinity")) fallback->pool("global-shared").

Nina (Infra): Dev roughs: Shielded 8-10w, Affinity 3-4w, Hybrid 6-8w. Assumes autoscaler + pool APIs reused.

Priya (SRE): Performance gates: p50<50ms (eu edge->endpoint), p99<250ms for shielded; canary ramp 0->10->50->100 over 72h; error budget <0.01% during ramp.

Maya (Security): Add must-haves: KMS rotation policy, audit export to customer bucket, encryption-at-rest attestation.

Rae (Product): Actions: Nina add cost/capacity estimates to RFC by Tue; Eli spike on model-variant parity (1w); Priya draft SRE checklist; Jules confirm pilot customer. Ill file RFC if no objections by Friday.

ops-bot: Reminder: attach RFC to /rfc and tag @sre-runbooks.
